//go:build finalqualification

package delivery

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type finalQualificationCustody struct{}

func (finalQualificationCustody) Use(ctx context.Context, i Intent, fn func([]byte) error) error {
	return fn([]byte("synthetic-fixture-only"))
}

type finalQualificationPrivacy struct{}

func (finalQualificationPrivacy) Review(context.Context, Intent, Plan) error { return nil }

type FinalQualificationRemote struct {
	sync.Mutex
	plan                              Plan
	Head                              string
	PRCreates, PRUpdates, IssueCloses int
	Calls                             int
	Writes                            int
	present                           map[string]bool
	published, pr, merged, closed     bool
}

var FinalQualificationControllerGitHub func(Plan) (*GitHub, error)

func (f *FinalQualificationRemote) SetPlan(p Plan) { f.Lock(); defer f.Unlock(); f.plan = p }
func (f *FinalQualificationRemote) Count() int     { f.Lock(); defer f.Unlock(); return f.Calls }
func finalProtection() map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{
		"enforce_admins":         map[string]bool{"enabled": true},
		"required_status_checks": map[string]any{"strict": true, "contexts": []string{"test"}, "checks": []any{}},
		"required_pull_request_reviews": map[string]any{
			"required_approving_review_count": 1, "dismiss_stale_reviews": true, "require_last_push_approval": true,
			"bypass_pull_request_allowances": map[string]any{"users": []any{}, "teams": []any{}, "apps": []any{}},
		},
	}
}
func FinalQualificationProtection() string { return digest(finalProtection()) }

// Only compiled by the source-owned finalqualification overlay. Never changes
// the production constructor, origin, credential policy or transport.
func FinalQualificationGitHub(t *testing.T, p Plan) (*GitHub, *FinalQualificationRemote) {
	t.Helper()
	f := &FinalQualificationRemote{present: map[string]bool{}, plan: p}
	// Remote advancement is a real unreachable Git commit made in a private index:
	// no worktree/index/ref moves and no synthetic compare result. It becomes the
	// live remote base only after the original PR was created.
	currentBase := ""
	git, err := exec.LookPath("git")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	objectRepository := p.Intake.Worktree
	if strings.Contains(t.Name(), "AdvancingBase") {
		objectRepository = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(p.Intake.Worktree), "controlled-upstream.git")
		if b, e := exec.Command(git, "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "clone", "--bare", "--no-local", p.Intake.Worktree, objectRepository).CombinedOutput(); e != nil {
			t.Fatalf("controlled remote: %s %v", b, e)
		}
	}
	fixtureGit := func(input []byte, args ...string) (string, error) {
		cmd := exec.Command(git, append([]string{"-C", objectRepository, "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null"}, args...)...)
		cmd.Env = []string{"PATH=" + filepath.Dir(git), "HOME=" + t.TempDir(), "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null", "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0", "GIT_INDEX_FILE=" + filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "index"), "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.invalid", "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture", "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.invalid", "GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2000-01-01T00:00:00Z", "GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2000-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(string(input))
		b, e := cmd.CombinedOutput()
		return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), e
	}
	if strings.Contains(t.Name(), "AdvancingBase") {
		// mktree input comes from the exact original tree, not the accepted edit.
		entries, e := fixtureGit(nil, "ls-tree", p.BaseHead)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		blob, e := fixtureGit([]byte("package main\nfunc Offset() int{return 7}\n"), "hash-object", "-w", "--stdin")
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		lines := strings.Split(entries, "\n")
		for i, line := range lines {
			if strings.HasSuffix(line, "	offset.go") {
				lines[i] = "100644 blob " + blob + "	offset.go"
			}
		}
		tree, e := fixtureGit([]byte(strings.Join(lines, "\n")+"\n"), "mktree")
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		currentBase, e = fixtureGit([]byte("Controlled upstream addition\n"), "commit-tree", tree, "-p", p.BaseHead)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	baseAdvanced := false
	liveBase := func() string {
		if currentBase != "" && baseAdvanced {
			return currentBase
		}
		return p.BaseHead
	}
	objects := map[string]GitObject{}
	for _, o := range p.Objects {
		objects[o.OID] = o
	}
	mergeSpec := p.Commit
	mergeSpec.Message = "Controlled squash result\n"
	mergeObject, e := authoredObject(mergeSpec)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	merge := mergeObject.OID
	prefix := "/repos/" + p.Repository
	person := func(i Identity) map[string]string {
		return map[string]string{"name": i.Name, "email": i.Email, "date": p.Commit.Timestamp}
	}
	pull := func() map[string]any {
		state, sha := "open", ""
		if f.merged {
			state, sha = "closed", merge
		}
		return map[string]any{"html_url": fmt.Sprintf("https://github.com/%s/pull/7", p.Repository), "user": map[string]string{"login": p.Actor}, "number": 7, "state": state, "draft": false, "merged": f.merged, "merge_commit_sha": sha, "mergeable": true, "mergeable_state": "clean", "title": p.PRTitle, "body": p.PRBody, "head": map[string]any{"sha": p.Head, "ref": p.Branch, "repo": map[string]any{"id": p.RepositoryID, "full_name": p.Repository}}, "base": map[string]any{"sha": liveBase(), "ref": p.Base, "repo": map[string]any{"id": p.RepositoryID, "full_name": p.Repository}}}
	}
	handler := http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		f.Lock()
		defer f.Unlock()
		p = f.plan
		for _, o := range p.Objects {
			objects[o.OID] = o
		}
		mergeSpec = p.Commit
		mergeSpec.Parent, mergeSpec.IntegrationParent = liveBase(), ""
		mergeSpec.Message = "Controlled squash result\n"
		mergeObject, _ = authoredObject(mergeSpec)
		merge = mergeObject.OID
		f.Calls++
		if r.Method != "GET" {
			f.Writes++
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		send := func(v any) { _ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v) }
		if r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer synthetic-fixture-only" {
			http.Error(w, "fixture credential missing", 401)
			return
		}
		path := r.URL.Path
		switch {
		case path == "/user":
			send(map[string]any{"id": 42, "login": p.Actor})
		case path == prefix:
			send(map[string]any{"id": p.RepositoryID, "full_name": p.Repository, "default_branch": p.Base, "permissions": map[string]bool{"push": true}, "allow_squash_merge": true})
		case path == prefix+"/rules/branches/"+p.Base:
			send([]any{})
		case path == prefix+"/branches/"+p.Base+"/protection":
			send(finalProtection())
		case path == prefix+"/collaborators/"+p.Actor+"/permission":
			send(map[string]string{"permission": "write", "role_name": "write"})
		case path == prefix+"/git/ref/heads/"+p.Base:
			head := liveBase()
			if f.merged {
				head = merge
			}
			send(map[string]any{"ref": "refs/heads/" + p.Base, "object": map[string]string{"sha": head}})
		case path == prefix+"/git/refs/heads/"+p.Branch && r.Method == "PATCH":
			var req struct {
				SHA   string
				Force bool
			}
			if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.Force || req.SHA != p.Head || f.Head != p.ExpectedOld {
				http.Error(w, "not exact nonforce successor", 422)
				return
			}
			f.Head = req.SHA
			send(map[string]any{"ref": "refs/heads/" + p.Branch, "object": map[string]string{"sha": f.Head}})
		case path == prefix+"/git/ref/heads/"+p.Branch:
			if !f.published {
				http.Error(w, "absent", 404)
				return
			}
			send(map[string]any{"ref": "refs/heads/" + p.Branch, "object": map[string]string{"sha": f.Head}})
		case path == prefix+"/git/refs":
			var req struct{ Ref, SHA string }
			if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.Ref != "refs/heads/"+p.Branch || req.SHA != p.Head {
				http.Error(w, "wrong ref", 422)
				return
			}
			f.published = true
			f.Head = p.Head
			send(map[string]any{"ref": req.Ref, "object": map[string]string{"sha": p.Head}})
		case path == prefix+"/pulls":
			if r.Method == "POST" {
				var req struct {
					Head, Base, Title, Body string
					Draft                   bool
				}
				if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.Head != p.Branch || req.Base != p.Base || req.Draft || req.Title != p.PRTitle || req.Body != p.PRBody {
					http.Error(w, "wrong PR", 422)
					return
				}
				f.pr = true
				f.PRCreates++
				if f.PRCreates != 1 {
					t.Error("duplicate PR")
				}
				send(pull())
				return
			}
			if f.pr {
				send([]any{pull()})
			} else {
				send([]any{})
			}
		case path == prefix+"/pulls/7":
			if currentBase != "" && r.Method == "GET" {
				baseAdvanced = true
			}
			if r.Method == "PATCH" {
				f.PRUpdates++
			}
			send(pull())
		case path == prefix+"/pulls/7/reviews":
			send([]any{map[string]any{"id": 1, "user": map[string]string{"login": "reviewer"}, "state": "APPROVED", "commit_id": p.Head, "submitted_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}})
		case path == prefix+"/pulls/7/merge":
			var req struct {
				SHA         string `json:"sha"`
				MergeMethod string `json:"merge_method"`
			}
			if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.SHA != p.Head || req.MergeMethod != p.MergeMethod {
				http.Error(w, "wrong reviewed merge", 422)
				return
			}
			f.merged = true
			send(map[string]any{"merged": true, "sha": merge})
		case strings.HasSuffix(path, "/check-runs"):
			parts := strings.Split(path, "/")
			head := parts[len(parts)-2]
			conclusion := "success"
			if strings.Contains(t.Name(), "FailedChecks") || (strings.Contains(t.Name(), "CIRepair") && p.ExpectedOld == "") {
				conclusion = "failure"
			}
			send(map[string]any{"total_count": 1, "check_runs": []any{map[string]any{"id": 123, "app": map[string]any{"id": 55, "slug": "ci"}, "name": "test", "head_sha": head, "status": "completed", "conclusion": conclusion}}})
		case strings.HasSuffix(path, "/status"):
			send(map[string]any{"total_count": 0, "statuses": []any{}})
		case strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix+"/compare/"):
			if currentBase != "" {
				pair := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(path, prefix+"/compare/"), "...")
				if len(pair) != 2 || !sha.MatchString(pair[0]) || !sha.MatchString(pair[1]) {
					http.Error(w, "bad comparison", 422)
					return
				}
				status := "diverged"
				if pair[0] == pair[1] {
					status = "identical"
				} else if _, e := fixtureGit(nil, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", pair[0], pair[1]); e == nil {
					status = "ahead"
				}
				behind := 0
				if status == "diverged" {
					behind = 1
				}
				send(map[string]any{"status": status, "behind_by": behind})
				return
			}
			send(map[string]any{"status": "identical", "behind_by": 0})
		case path == prefix+"/issues/"+strconv.FormatUint(p.Intake.Source.URL.Number, 10):
			if r.Method == "PATCH" {
				var req struct {
					State       string
					StateReason string `json:"state_reason"`
				}
				if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.State != "closed" || req.StateReason != "completed" {
					http.Error(w, "wrong issue", 422)
					return
				}
				f.closed = true
				f.IssueCloses++
				if f.IssueCloses != 1 {
					t.Error("duplicate issue close")
				}
			}
			state, reason := "open", ""
			if f.closed {
				state, reason = "closed", "completed"
			}
			send(map[string]any{"id": p.Intake.Source.IssueID, "number": p.Intake.Source.URL.Number, "state": state, "state_reason": reason})
		case strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix+"/git/"):
			tail := strings.TrimPrefix(path, prefix+"/git/")
			parts := strings.Split(tail, "/")
			kind := strings.TrimSuffix(parts[0], "s")
			if len(parts) == 1 && r.Method == "POST" {
				var found GitObject
				switch kind {
				case "blob":
					var req struct{ Content, Encoding string }
					if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.Encoding != "base64" {
						http.Error(w, "bad blob", 422)
						return
					}
					b, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(req.Content)
					if err != nil {
						http.Error(w, "bad base64", 422)
						return
					}
					found = GitObject{Kind: "blob", OID: objectOID("blob", b), Raw: b}
				case "tree":
					var req struct{ Tree []treeEntry }
					if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil {
						http.Error(w, "bad tree", 422)
						return
					}
					for _, o := range p.Objects {
						if o.Kind == "tree" {
							entries, e := treeEntries(o.Raw)
							if e == nil && reflect.DeepEqual(entries, req.Tree) {
								found = o
							}
						}
					}
				case "commit":
					var req gitCommitPayload
					if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil {
						http.Error(w, "bad commit", 422)
						return
					}
					for _, o := range p.Objects {
						if o.Kind == "commit" {
							expected, e := commitPayload(o)
							if e == nil && reflect.DeepEqual(expected, req) {
								found = o
							}
						}
					}
				}
				expected, ok := objects[found.OID]
				if !ok || !reflect.DeepEqual(expected, found) {
					http.Error(w, "unapproved object", 422)
					return
				}
				f.present[found.OID] = true
				if currentBase != "" {
					actual, err := fixtureGit(found.Raw, "hash-object", "-t", found.Kind, "-w", "--stdin")
					if err != nil || actual != found.OID {
						http.Error(w, "object persistence failed", 422)
						return
					}
				}
				send(map[string]string{"sha": found.OID})
				return
			}
			if len(parts) != 2 {
				http.Error(w, "bad object path", 404)
				return
			}
			id := parts[1]
			if kind == "commit" && id == p.BaseHead {
				send(map[string]string{"sha": id})
				return
			}
			if kind == "commit" && id == merge {
				send(map[string]any{"sha": id, "message": mergeSpec.Message, "tree": map[string]string{"sha": p.Commit.Tree}, "parents": []any{map[string]string{"sha": p.BaseHead}}, "author": person(p.Commit.Author), "committer": person(p.Commit.Committer)})
				return
			}
			o, ok := objects[id]
			if !ok || !f.present[id] {
				http.Error(w, "absent", 404)
				return
			}
			switch kind {
			case "blob":
				send(map[string]string{"sha": id, "encoding": "base64", "content": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(o.Raw)})
			case "tree":
				entries, e := treeEntries(o.Raw)
				if e != nil {
					t.Error(e)
				}
				send(map[string]any{"sha": id, "truncated": false, "tree": entries})
			case "commit":
				payload, e := commitPayload(o)
				if e != nil {
					t.Error(e)
				}
				parents := []any{}
				for _, parent := range payload.Parents { parents = append(parents, map[string]string{"sha": parent}) }
				send(map[string]any{"sha": id, "message": payload.Message, "tree": map[string]string{"sha": payload.Tree}, "parents": parents, "author": payload.Author, "committer": payload.Committer})
			default:
				http.Error(w, "unsupported kind", 404)
			}
		default:
			t.Errorf("unhandled fixture endpoint %s %s", r.Method, path)
			http.Error(w, "unsupported fixture", 404)
		}
	})
	origin, scope, detach, e := finalQualificationHTTP.attach(p, handler)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	t.Cleanup(detach)
	remote, e := newGitHub(origin, finalQualificationCustody{}, finalQualificationPrivacy{})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	// Wrap the actual constructor's transport; preserve its proxy, redirect,
	// timeout, origin/path, authorization and request-body behavior.
	remote.client.Transport = finalQualificationScopeTransport{remote.client.Transport, scope}
	return remote, f
}

const finalQualificationScopeHeader = "X-Aegis-Final-Qualification-Scope"

type finalQualificationScopeTransport struct {
	base  http.RoundTripper
	scope string
}

func (tr finalQualificationScopeTransport) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	clone := r.Clone(r.Context())
	clone.Header.Set(finalQualificationScopeHeader, tr.scope)
	return tr.base.RoundTrip(clone)
}

type finalQualificationHTTPEntry struct {
	handler http.Handler
	active  sync.WaitGroup
}

type finalQualificationHTTPRegistry struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	server  *httptest.Server
	closing chan struct{}
	entries map[string]*finalQualificationHTTPEntry
	// Includes detached entries until their own active handlers finish.
	live int
}

var finalQualificationHTTP finalQualificationHTTPRegistry

// Invoked by a finalqualification-only regression root with the actual overlay.
// No production package or ordinary test refers to these overlay-only helpers.
func FinalQualificationListenerRegression(t *testing.T) {
	var registry finalQualificationHTTPRegistry
	attach := func(p Plan, h http.Handler) (string, string, func()) {
		t.Helper()
		u, key, cleanup, err := registry.attach(p, h)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Cleanup(cleanup)
		return u, key, cleanup
	}
	client := &http.Client{Transport: &http.Transport{Proxy: nil, DisableKeepAlives: true}, Timeout: 3 * time.Second}
	t.Cleanup(client.CloseIdleConnections)
	request := func(origin string, keys []string) (int, string, error) {
		req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", origin+"/exact/path?query=unchanged", nil)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, "", err
		}
		for _, key := range keys {
			req.Header.Add(finalQualificationScopeHeader, key)
		}
		resp, err := client.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, "", err
		}
		defer resp.Body.Close()
		b, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		return resp.StatusCode, string(b), err
	}
	check := func(u string, keys []string, status int, body string) {
		t.Helper()
		got, b, err := request(u, keys)
		if err != nil || got != status || (body != "" && b != body) {
			t.Fatalf("controlled request: status=%d body=%q error=%v want %d %q", got, b, err, status, body)
		}
	}
	handler := func(body string) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if r.URL.RequestURI() != "/exact/path?query=unchanged" {
				t.Error("route changed original URL")
			}
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, body)
		})
	}
	plan := func(run, contract string) Plan { return Plan{Reference: Reference{Run: run, Contract: contract}} }
	root := plan("listener-regression", "one")
	for _, p := range []Plan{{}, plan(root.Run, ""), plan("", root.Contract)} {
		if _, _, _, err := registry.attach(p, handler("bad")); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("accepted missing root")
		}
	}
	u, a, closeA := attach(root, handler("one"))
	u2, b, closeB := attach(plan(root.Run, "two"), handler("two"))
	if u != u2 || a == b {
		t.Fatal("not one listener with exact independent roots")
	}
	if _, _, _, err := registry.attach(root, handler("duplicate")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted duplicate root")
	}
	check(u, nil, 404, "")
	check(u, []string{"foreign"}, 404, "")
	check(u, []string{a, a}, 404, "")
	check(u, []string{a, b}, 404, "")
	check(u, []string{a + "," + b}, 404, "")
	var requests sync.WaitGroup
	for i := 0; i < 20; i++ {
		for key, want := range map[string]string{a: "one", b: "two"} {
			requests.Add(1)
			go func(key, want string) {
				defer requests.Done()
				status, body, err := request(u, []string{key})
				if err != nil || status != 200 || body != want {
					t.Errorf("cross-fixture request: %d %q %v", status, body, err)
				}
			}(key, want)
		}
	}
	requests.Wait()
	closeA()
	check(u, []string{a}, 404, "")
	check(u, []string{b}, 200, "two")
	_, replacement, closeReplacement := attach(root, handler("replacement"))
	closeA() // stale cleanup cannot delete the replacement.
	check(u, []string{replacement}, 200, "replacement")
	closeReplacement()
	closeB()
	registry.mu.Lock()
	closed := registry.server == nil && registry.live == 0 && registry.closing == nil
	registry.mu.Unlock()
	if !closed {
		t.Fatal("last cleanup retained server")
	}
	if conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", strings.TrimPrefix(u, "http://"), time.Second); err == nil {
		conn.Close()
		t.Fatal("last listener still open")
	}

	// Deletion waits for its own active request, while another fixture's
	// cleanup and a replacement attach can proceed without the global lock.
	entered, release := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	var releaseOnce sync.Once
	unblock := func() { releaseOnce.Do(func() { close(release) }) }
	defer unblock()
	u, a, closeA = attach(root, http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		close(entered)
		<-release
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, "drained")
	}))
	_, b, closeB = attach(plan(root.Run, "other"), handler("other"))
	response := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		status, body, err := request(u, []string{a})
		if err == nil && (status != 200 || body != "drained") {
			err = fmt.Errorf("active response %d %q", status, body)
		}
		response <- err
	}()
	select {
	case <-entered:
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("handler never entered")
	}
	detached := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { closeA(); close(detached) }()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)
	for {
		registry.mu.Lock()
		removed := registry.entries[a] == nil
		registry.mu.Unlock()
		if removed {
			break
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("detach held global lock")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
	select {
	case <-detached:
		t.Fatal("cleanup did not wait for active handler")
	default:
	}
	check(u, []string{a}, 404, "")
	closeB()
	// Even with no attached entries, the detached active handler retains the listener.
	check(u, []string{b}, 404, "")
	_, replacement, closeReplacement = attach(root, handler("successor"))
	check(u, []string{replacement}, 200, "successor")
	unblock()
	select {
	case err := <-response:
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("active response stuck")
	}
	select {
	case <-detached:
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("cleanup stuck")
	}
	closeA()
	check(u, []string{replacement}, 200, "successor")
	closeReplacement()

	// Repeatedly race the last close against a new attach on the same claim.
	// Either it joins the old listener or waits for Close before rebinding.
	for i := 0; i < 30; i++ {
		_, _, oldClose := attach(root, handler("old"))
		done := make(chan struct{})
		go func() { oldClose(); close(done) }()
		nextURL, nextKey, nextClose := attach(plan(root.Run, fmt.Sprint(i)), handler("next"))
		check(nextURL, []string{nextKey}, 200, "next")
		select {
		case <-done:
		case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
			t.Fatal("last close/attach deadlock")
		}
		oldClose()
		check(nextURL, []string{nextKey}, 200, "next")
		nextClose()
	}

	// The scoped client wraps the ORIGINAL constructor transport, clones the
	// request, and changes only the private routing header.
	u, a, finish := attach(root, http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(req.Body)
		if req.Method != "POST" || req.URL.RequestURI() != "/original?query=1" || string(body) != "original-body" || req.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer synthetic-fixture-only" {
			t.Error("transport changed original protocol")
		}
		if req.Header.Get(finalQualificationScopeHeader) != a { t.Error("client did not fix its registered route") }
		w.Header().Set("Location", "/must-not-follow")
		w.WriteHeader(302)
	}))
	gh, err := newGitHub(u, finalQualificationCustody{}, finalQualificationPrivacy{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	original := gh.client.Transport
	tr, ok := original.(*http.Transport)
	if !ok || tr.Proxy != nil || gh.client.CheckRedirect == nil {
		t.Fatal("constructor guard changed")
	}
	defer tr.CloseIdleConnections()
	gh.client.Transport = finalQualificationScopeTransport{original, a}
	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", u+"/original?query=1", strings.NewReader("original-body"))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer synthetic-fixture-only")
	req.Header.Set(finalQualificationScopeHeader, "unregistered-conflict")
	resp, err := gh.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode != 302 || req.Header.Get(finalQualificationScopeHeader) != "unregistered-conflict" || req.URL.String() != u+"/original?query=1" {
		t.Fatal("redirect denial or request cloning changed")
	}
	finish()
}

func (r *finalQualificationHTTPRegistry) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
	values := req.Header.Values(finalQualificationScopeHeader)
	r.mu.Lock()
	var entry *finalQualificationHTTPEntry
	if len(values) == 1 && values[0] != "" {
		entry = r.entries[values[0]]
	}
	if entry != nil {
		entry.active.Add(1)
	}
	r.mu.Unlock()
	if entry == nil {
		http.Error(w, "unknown controlled fixture scope", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	defer entry.active.Done()
	entry.handler.ServeHTTP(w, req)
}

func (r *finalQualificationHTTPRegistry) attach(p Plan, handler http.Handler) (string, string, func(), error) {
	if p.Run == "" || p.Contract == "" || handler == nil {
		return "", "", nil, fmt.Errorf("missing controlled fixture root or handler")
	}
	// JSON length-delimits both immutable fields; Candidate may legitimately change.
	root, _ := json.Marshal([2]string{p.Run, p.Contract})
	scope := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(root))
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("AEGIS_ACCEPTANCE_PORT"))
	if err != nil || port < 8450 || port > 8469 {
		return "", "", nil, fmt.Errorf("final qualification requires shared acceptance_port.py lifetime custody")
	}
	for {
		r.mu.Lock()
		if closing := r.closing; closing != nil {
			r.mu.Unlock()
			<-closing
			continue
		}
		if r.entries[scope] != nil {
			r.mu.Unlock()
			return "", "", nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate controlled fixture root")
		}
		if r.server == nil {
			// The outer helper owns the ONE claimed listener's whole process group.
			// Literal construction avoids even a transient ephemeral listener.
			listener, listenErr := net.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", port))
			if listenErr != nil {
				r.mu.Unlock()
				return "", "", nil, listenErr
			}
			r.server = &httptest.Server{Listener: listener, Config: &http.Server{Handler: r}}
			r.server.Start()
			r.entries = make(map[string]*finalQualificationHTTPEntry)
		}
		entry := &finalQualificationHTTPEntry{handler: handler}
		r.entries[scope] = entry
		r.live++
		origin := r.server.URL
		r.mu.Unlock()
		var once sync.Once
		detach := func() {
			once.Do(func() {
				r.mu.Lock()
				if r.entries[scope] == entry {
					delete(r.entries, scope)
				}
				r.mu.Unlock()
				// No additions can follow deletion. Wait only for this fixture and
				// never hold the registry lock across handlers, waits or Close.
				entry.active.Wait()
				r.mu.Lock()
				r.live--
				if r.live != 0 {
					r.mu.Unlock()
					return
				}
				server := r.server
				r.server = nil
				closing := make(chan struct{})
				r.closing = closing
				r.mu.Unlock()
				server.Close()
				r.mu.Lock()
				r.closing = nil
				close(closing)
				r.mu.Unlock()
			})
		}
		return origin, scope, detach, nil
	}
}
